text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm happy to help clear this up.

**This is most likely not a mistake.** We charge your card when each parcel ships, so an order that arrives in two boxes can show one charge per box. The two charges should add up to your order total (plus any shipping).

**To check:**
- Compare the two charges with your order total. If they add up to it, everything is working as expected.
- One of them may be a pending authorisation rather than a second charge. Those are placed at checkout and usually drop off on their own.

**If it still looks like a duplicate** (for example, you were charged the full amount twice), please send me:
- Your order number (it looks like LF-123456)
- The last four digits of the card used

Please don't share your full card number, security code, or any passwords. Once we confirm a duplicate, it will be refunded within **3 business days**.

Do you want to tell me what the two amounts are? I can help you work out whether they match your order. Enjoy your new plants, and reach out any time!
